original.statement: When CRDs are installed separately, operators must first bump the CRDs by applying the v0.16.1 deploy/crds/bundle.yaml and check that no error occurs, and only then upgrade external-secrets to v0.16.1.

decision.reason: [ev-4139b0de79e3] says that if CRDs are installed separately, "the first step you need to do is bump the crds" by applying the v0.16.1 bundle.yaml and checking that no error occurs, before moving external-secrets to v0.16.1. That is a required step the operator must carry out, so the migration family with migration-required is correct. The name "bump-crds" is short kebab-case taken from the evidence's own words.
